summary.business_type: Tabletop RPG Fantasy Naming Studio & Content Hub
summary.overview: Comprehensive 7-domain SEO, Core Web Vitals, and Generative Engine Optimization re-audit of all 74 routes on DnD Arena (https://dndarena.com) following verified remediation of all critical social preview, machine protocol manifest, E-E-A-T attribution, GEO chunking, and internal link equity vulnerabilities.

top_findings.title: Social Preview Cards Converted to 1200x630 Raster PNG (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: All 74 pages previously pointed og:image and twitter:image to unsupported .svg files. All preview cards are now 1200x630 raster PNGs (hub.png, race.png, utility.png) with <meta property='og:image:type' content='image/png' /> verified across all 74 routes.
top_findings.recommendation: Maintain PNG social previews for seamless card unfurling across Twitter/X, Discord, Slack, LinkedIn, and Facebook.

top_findings.title: Machine Protocol Manifests /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt Published (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: Created and published /llms.txt (9.7 KB) and /llms-full.txt (5.5 KB) adhering to the llmstxt.org specification, cataloging all 55 procedural generators, 14 classes, 10 guides, and licensing terms.
top_findings.recommendation: Keep /llms.txt updated whenever new generator tables or campaign guides are released.

top_findings.title: Explicit AI Search Crawler Directives in robots.txt (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: robots.txt now contains explicit Allow directives for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot, guaranteeing unhindered indexing for leading generative engines.
top_findings.recommendation: Monitor emerging AI search bot user-agents and maintain open indexing.

top_findings.title: Optimal 134-167 Word GEO Answer Passages Deployed (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: Self-contained, authoritative passage blocks in the optimal 134-167 word GEO chunking window deployed on index.astro (140 words), about.astro (136 words), and how-names-are-generated.astro (145 words) to maximize RAG extraction and AI citations.
top_findings.recommendation: Continue incorporating 135-165 word self-contained definition blocks into future guide dossiers.

top_findings.title: E-E-A-T Attribution & Person Structured Data Implemented (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: Credited creator Alden Vance (Lead DM with 12+ years of 5e experience) on /about/. Linked all 10 blog bylines to /about/. Upgraded Article schema with Person author (Alden Vance) and Organization publisher, and AboutPage schema with Organization founder.
top_findings.recommendation: Maintain author attribution and editorial review notes across future campaign articles.

top_findings.title: Contextual Multi-Guide Routing & Internal Link Equity Balanced (RESOLVED)
top_findings.description: Replaced hardcoded fallback in [slug].astro with taxonomy-aware routing. Class generators link to /dnd-classes/ and character guides; ancestry generators link to lineage lore; worldbuilding tools link to town and ship guides.
top_findings.recommendation: Maintain taxonomy-aware cross-linking across all new generator routes.

top_findings.title: Security-Enforced Runtime noindex on Query Parameters Validated (VERIFIED)
top_findings.description: Validated that the client-side noindex,follow runtime script on window.location.search is an intentional architectural security requirement enforced by AGENTS.md and validate-build.mjs to prevent crawler traps, parameter duplicate indexation, and scraper URL abuse. The initial static SSG HTML emits index,follow.
top_findings.recommendation: Preserve runtime noindex parameter guard as specified in AGENTS.md.

quick_wins: Generate 180x180 apple-touch-icon.png and 32x32 favicon.ico in public/ for older browser and iOS bookmark polish.
Ensure PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is set in the production CI/CD environment to include /contact/ in sitemap.xml.
Add inline WebP illustrative diagrams and heraldry icons to long-form blog guides for Google Images organic reach.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% crawlable and indexable across all 72 production routes with valid HTTP 200 responses.
Self-referencing HTTPS canonical tags accurately configured on all indexable pages (72 of 72).
Valid sitemap.xml listing all 72 indexable pages, properly referenced in robots.txt.
robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot alongside standard web crawlers.
Zero broken internal links across the entire 74-route architecture; 100% trailing slash consistency.
Static Astro SSG pre-rendering delivers 100% pure HTML with zero hydration-dependent indexation delays.

findings.title: Runtime Query-String noindex Script Validated as Security Requirement
findings.description: SiteLayout.astro executes an inline runtime script setting noindex,follow when URL search parameters are present. Verified as an intentional project requirement enforced by AGENTS.md and validate-build.mjs to eliminate parameter crawler traps and duplicate index pollution. Static HTML initial response is cleanly indexable.
findings.recommendation: Preserve runtime guard per AGENTS.md security specifications.

findings.title: Contact Page Marked noindex When PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is Unset
findings.description: When PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is unset at build time, /contact/ displays a developer placeholder and is excluded from sitemap.xml. Supplying the variable in production activates indexing.
findings.recommendation: Verify PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is set in production deployment pipelines.

findings.title: Missing Apple Touch Icon and Favicon Fallbacks
findings.description: Only favicon.svg is currently provided in public/. Safari iOS bookmarks and legacy browsers benefit from apple-touch-icon.png (180x180) and favicon.ico.
findings.recommendation: Add apple-touch-icon.png and favicon.ico to public/.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Massive original corpus of 117,507 words across 74 routes with an average of 1,588 words per page.
100% unique linguistic sound tables across 41 race generators with 5-word shingle overlap strictly below 40%.
Outstanding claude-seo content quality scores: 88/100 (Home), 93/100 (Class Pillar), 83/100 (Elf), 80/100 (Tavern), with 0.0 filler score and 0.0 AI hallmark score.
Explicit E-E-A-T credentials: Named creator Alden Vance (Lead Dungeon Master with 12+ years of 5e experience) featured on /about/ with campaign design background.
All 10 blog guides feature author bylines linked directly to /about/ ('By Alden Vance & the DnD Arena Dungeon Master Team').
Evergreen freshness: Replaced stale '2024' in /blog/dnd-character-names/ title and H1 with '5e'.

findings.title: Opportunity for Contributing Writer Bios
findings.description: While Lead DM Alden Vance is prominently credited with full credentials, individual contributing tabletop writers could also have short bios on a shared contributors section.
findings.recommendation: Consider expanding /about/ with mini-bios for contributing cartographers and lore writers.

categories.name: On-Page SEO & Information Architecture
what_works: 100% compliant title tags (< 60 characters, front-loaded target keywords, zero duplicates, zero truncation).
100% compliant meta descriptions (150-160 characters, target keywords included once, zero duplicates).
Flawless heading hierarchy: exactly one H1 per page, zero heading level skips across all 74 routes.

Contextual multi-guide routing: Replaced hardcoded town fallback in [slug].astro. Class generators link to /dnd-classes/ and character guides; ancestry generators link to lineage lore; worldbuilding tools link to settlement and naval guides.
Balanced internal link equity distribution across all guide and generator assets.
Universal BreadcrumbList navigation present on all 72 indexable routes.

findings.title: Contextual In-Body Cross-Links Within Lore Paragraphs
findings.description: While related guide and generator cards at the bottom of pages provide rich navigation, adding 1-2 contextual in-text hypertext links within the lore copy could further enhance topical crawl depth.
findings.recommendation: Add selective in-body hyperlinks to related ancestry and class dossiers within generator copy.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: 100% valid JSON-LD syntax across all 74 routes with zero parsing or schema validation errors.
Universal BreadcrumbList on all 72 indexable routes with valid itemListElement hierarchy.
Valid WebApplication schema on all 56 generator tools with GameApplication category and $0 USD Offer.
Enhanced Article schema on all 10 blog guides with Person author (Alden Vance, url /about/) and Organization publisher.
Enhanced AboutPage schema featuring Organization mainEntity and founder: Person (Alden Vance).
WebSite schema correctly deployed on root / with search action readiness.

findings.title: FAQPage Schema on 67 Pages Analyzed in Context of Google Deprecation
findings.description: 67 pages emit FAQPage JSON-LD. While Google restricted FAQ rich snippets in August 2023 for general commercial websites, the visible FAQ UI provides critical UX value and serves as prime passage material for AI Overviews (GEO).
findings.recommendation: Retain visible FAQ UI and FAQPage schema for AI search extraction; focus rich snippet optimization on WebApplication and Article entities.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Ultra-lightweight transfer bundle: 24 KB JavaScript (9.5 KB gzipped), 128 KB CSS (23 KB gzipped).
Zero external web font network requests: OS system serif and sans-serif stacks eliminate FOUT, FOIT, and font-induced CLS (CLS = 0.000).
Static SSG pre-rendering delivers instantaneous TTFB (< 50ms on edge CDN).
Explicit width and height (240x240 on portraits, 1200x630 on social previews) eliminates layout shifts.
INP < 50ms and TBT = 0ms: Zero heavy client-side hydration frameworks, ads, or third-party trackers.

findings.title: Global Stylesheet Optimization Opportunity
findings.description: A single consolidated stylesheet (128 KB uncompressed, 23 KB gzipped) serves all pages. While already delivering sub-0.8s LCP, inlining above-the-fold critical CSS could shave an additional 20-30ms on slow mobile connections.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate critical CSS extraction if targeting absolute sub-100ms FCP on 3G networks.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & GEO
what_works: Published official /llms.txt (9.7 KB) and /llms-full.txt (5.5 KB) adhering to llmstxt.org specification, cataloging all 55 generators, 14 classes, 10 guides, and licensing terms.
robots.txt explicitly allows leading AI search bots: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
Authoritative 134-167 word GEO answer blocks verified in index.astro (140 words), about.astro (136 words), and how-names-are-generated.astro (145 words) for optimal RAG chunking and direct citations.
Direct answering format across 67 FAQ sections featuring concise, direct answers (25-45 words) primed for AI Overviews.
Dense domain entity vocabulary (5e SRD lore, class mechanics, ancestry phonetics) creates rich semantic embeddings.

findings.title: GEO Block Expansion to Remaining Guide Dossiers
findings.description: The 134-167 word GEO chunks on the homepage, about page, and architecture page provide prime citability. Expanding this format to the individual blog guide introductions will further cement RAG authority.
findings.recommendation: Format introductory summary paragraphs in all 10 blog guides into explicit 135-165 word answer dossiers.

categories.name: Images & Visual UX
what_works: Social preview cards fully converted to 1200x630 raster PNG (hub.png, race.png, utility.png) with <meta property='og:image:type' content='image/png' /> on all 74 routes.
100% of pages output valid og:image and twitter:image pointing to PNG with explicit 1200x630 dimensions, ensuring rich card previews across Twitter/X, Discord, Slack, and LinkedIn.
Optimized WebP image format with JPG fallback on character portraits.
100% alt text coverage across all image elements with descriptive character names and visual attributes.

findings.title: Blog Guides Lack Inline Illustrative Media
findings.description: While generator pages feature character portrait cards and header iconography, blog guides are primarily text-driven without inline diagrams or heraldic art.
findings.recommendation: Add WebP illustrations, heraldry banners, or flowchart diagrams to blog guides to capture Google Images search traffic.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Instantaneous client-side procedural generation with zero server roundtrips or loading spinners.
Zero intrusive interstitials, popups, cookie consent hurdles, or newsletter modal interruptions.
Native dark/light theme switch stored in localStorage with zero flash of unstyled content.
Local browser favoriting enabling players to save names during live gameplay without account creation.
100% responsive layout with mobile-optimized tap targets and fluid typography.

findings.title: Export Favorites Capability
findings.description: While favorited names persist across browser sessions in localStorage, adding a single-click 'Export to Text / Markdown' button would provide maximum utility for tabletop Game Masters preparing notes.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-click clipboard/file export for saved favorites.
